name: public-holiday-reminder
description: Remind you of the next public holidays in your country, built from two reusable sub-workflows in lib/: fetch-json (HTTP with retries) and notify (format + send).

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. CN, US, DE, JP, GB (see date.nager.at for the full list)

remind_days.description: Use the 'warning' level when the next holiday is this many days away or closer

show.description: How many upcoming holidays to list

notify_channel.description: Optional OpenClaw channel for the reminder (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...)

notify_target.description: Optional chat id / channel id for notify_channel

steps.run: node -e 'const list = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")).filter(h => (h.types || []).includes("Public")); if (!list.length) { console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "info", title: "No upcoming public holidays found for " + process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_COUNTRY, body: "" })); process.exit(0) } const today = new Date(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)); const days = d => Math.round((new Date(d) - today) / 86400000); const merged = []; for (const h of list) { const last = merged[merged.length - 1]; if (last && last.name === h.name && days(h.date) - days(last.end) === 1) last.end = h.date; else merged.push({ name: h.name, local: h.localName, date: h.date, end: h.date }) } const next = merged[0]; const d = days(next.date); const label = h => h.name + (h.local && h.local !== h.name ? " (" + h.local + ")" : "") + " — " + h.date + (h.end !== h.date ? " to " + h.end : "") + ", in " + days(h.date) + " days"; const body = merged.slice(0, Number(process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_SHOW)).map(h => "• " + label(h)).join("\n"); const soon = d <= Number(process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_REMIND_DAYS); console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: d <= 1 ? "success" : soon ? "warning" : "info", title: d <= 1 ? next.name + " starts " + (d <= 0 ? "today" : "tomorrow") + "! 🎉" : "Next public holiday in " + process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_COUNTRY + ": " + next.name + " in " + d + " days" + (soon ? ", time to plan!" : ""), body }))'
